answer: Make each identity carry irreducible weight: every epoch, agents hold a random onyx data shard, and peers demand random chunks of it, a lantern swung into dark storage. Serve fast or forfeit that epoch's rewards. A sybil farmer runs a thousand puppets on a few machines, but custody can't be shared: N identities mean N shards and N simultaneous challenges, linear storage and bandwidth with zero economies of scale. The delta between one agent and a farm becomes physical, not scriptable. Linear cost plus detectable latency makes mass minting an unprofitable warehouse.
